messages.english: The publication page describes the Ontario vegetable production guide and links its PDF. This review covers the publication page and its displayed dates.
The guide PDF, dataset reuse rights and local growing recommendations require separate review.
The official index describes 1991–2020 historical climate normals and offers station searches and bulk CSV downloads.
Station records, frost dates and dataset terms remain unverified. Historical station summaries provide context for a location and time period.
